Merge per-VPU fabrics into domain products with globally unique IDs

Source: R/merge_vpus.R
merge_vpus.Rd

Assigns globally unique IDs across every VPU in gpkg_map, then writes one GeoPackage per domain:

  • superconus_ngen.gpkg: VPUs 01-18

  • ak_ngen.gpkg: VPU 19

  • hi_ngen.gpkg: VPU 20

  • prvi_ngen.gpkg: VPU 21

  • guam_ngen.gpkg: VPU 22, only when it is in gpkg_map (not part of the NWM v4 delivery)

Usage

merge_vpus(
  gpkg_map,
  out_dir,
  mods_csv = system.file("extdata", "rpu_vpu_out.csv", package = "hydrofabric"),
  overwrite = FALSE,
  strict = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE,
  grouping = c("vpu", "tdx_continent"),
  target_crs = "EPSG:4326"
)

Arguments

gpkg_map

Named list mapping vpuid -> absolute path to ngen_vpu*.gpkg. All VPUs that should participate in the global ID pool must be present. Example: list("01" = "/path/ngen_vpu01.gpkg", "19" = "/path/ngen_vpu19.gpkg")

out_dir

Directory where output gpkgs are written.

mods_csv

Path to the cross-VPU COMID modifications CSV (CONUS only). Defaults to the vendored copy in inst/extdata/rpu_vpu_out.csv.

overwrite

If TRUE, delete existing output files before writing.

strict

If TRUE (default), the merge is fail-fast: unresolved cross-VPU topology and invariant failures abort the run.

verbose

Emit per-layer progress messages.

grouping

How to partition VPUs into output domains: "vpu" (default) groups by the leading integer of vpuid (country/VPU domain); "tdx_continent" groups by the leading digit of the TDX-Hydro HydroBASINS level-2 id (continent).

target_crs

Output coordinate reference system for the merged domain products (default "EPSG:4326").

Value

Invisibly, a list with outfiles, fp_map, poi_map, cross_vpu_fix, invariants (one per domain product).

Details

IDs are assigned in contiguous blocks in VPU order, so a flowpath id such as fp-450003 belongs to exactly one VPU in any domain.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
gpkg_map <- list("01" = "out/vpu_01/ngen_vpu01.gpkg",
                 "19" = "out/vpu_19/ngen_vpu19.gpkg")
merge_vpus(gpkg_map, out_dir = "out/global", overwrite = TRUE)
} # }
